title: Yggdrasil
tagline: One-Stop DeFi solution for no-brainer investments.
description: We are a multi chain protocol where normal users can invest into complex as well as the simplets of strategies proposed by the "Strategists". Strategists have the flexibility to have a strategy completely onchain, completely offchain or a mixture of both. We are providing the infrastructure where strategists and crypto natives meet. Did we mention, this is all while the user funds are returned to the user at the end of each transaction and does no depend on a vault structure on the protocol level.
how_its_made:
- Navigating the different chains we have deployed on and small caveats that make each chain's deployment unique.
- Using event listeners to implement partial on-chain and off-chain strategies using Fusion API.
- Verification of a multi-file contract on Scroll chain.
